name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: December 1 is an annual priority deadline; no explicit Fall 2027 date was established. Funding pages conflict between an all-new-doctoral-students statement and competitive/limited availability; confirm the individual offer.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published priority deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: For the following Fall. Late applications may be reviewed if space remains; references are due by December 1.

english.toefl: 79 (4.5 on the new scale); Essentials C1
english.note: Current central graduate minima also list PTE 53, Cambridge C2, LanguageCert 74 with no skill below 60, Oxford 140 and PTE Express 85. The department's older TOEFL 79–80 wording differs; central current minimum retained. Exemptions include qualifying bachelor's degrees in the U.S., English-speaking Canada, UK, South Africa, Australia or New Zealand, qualifying U.S. English-composition coursework, CELAC Academic Bridge and listed English-speaking countries; no general overseas English-medium-degree exemption inferred.

applicationFee.note: International application $70; domestic $60. Central Graduate Studies waivers exclude international applicants. Any separate Biology departmental sponsorship was not established.

documents: Letter of intent describing goals, UNM study plans and research interests (typically two to three pages)
Transcripts from all higher education institutions; unofficial uploads and official copies required before acceptance
At least one prospective faculty adviser listed in the application
English proficiency evidence and additional GEO documents for international applicants
requirements.note: Bachelor's degree before entry (not necessarily biology); GPA at least 3.2 in biology and other sciences; two introductory biology semesters, one genetics semester and at least 12 upper-level biology credits. Exception petitions possible for exceptionally qualified applicants. Admission requires faculty agreement to advise; contact prospective faculty before applying. GRE is described as optional and excluded from admission decisions, but submitted scores remain available to faculty. Writing sample not required; other publications/materials optional. Indicate assistantship interest and email biograd@unm.edu after completing the application.

funding.note: Financial Support page says five-year support for new doctoral students in good standing, then calls assistantships competitive; application page says limited support may be offered. No universal guarantee asserted. Listed academic-year assistantships require 20 hours/week and provide stipend, basic health insurance and up to 12 Biology-related tuition credits per semester. International students without an assistantship may be nominated for Amigo support; nomination and terms must be confirmed.
